shelters: Lägerplats Stora Iglakärr: shelter/fireplace/toilet/picnic table, built spring 2025.
Lägerplats Stensjön: shelter for 4-5 adults, fireplace/wood store nearby, no drinking water.
Lägerplats Fjärås Bräcka Biet and Humlan: official shelters near endpoint; reserve camping rule ambiguity must be resolved before describing overnight use.
fireRules: Hallandsleden advises checking current fire-risk/fire-ban status and using established fireplaces.
In Fjärås Bräcka nature reserve, fires are allowed only at designated places.
Do not store static no-fire-ban status; current fire bans are dynamic and should be checked via Brandrisk Ute/Krisinformation/municipal or Länsstyrelsen information.
campingRules: Fjärås Bräcka reserve regulations prohibit camping/tents and caravan/motorhome setup.
Länsstyrelsen Halland FAQ says camping prohibitions can also cover overnighting in shelters, tarp, hammock with roof; clarify before import text implies overnight shelter use at Biet/Humlan.
Short camping under allemansrätten may be possible outside restricted areas, but section text should defer to reserve and local rules.

protectedAreas.name: Fjärås Bräcka naturreservat
protectedAreas.sectionRelevance: Section enters the reserve near the southern/end part after Fjärås church; Hallandsleden passes through the reserve.
rules: No camping or setting up caravan/motorhome.
No motor vehicles off-road or parking outside designated areas.
Horse riding/driving only on marked routes/areas; Länsstyrelsen notes no marked riding areas/routes currently exist, so riding is only allowed on roads.

dogRules.summary: Use strict leash wording. Hallandsleden says dogs should always be leashed on the trail; dog page notes stricter supervision from 1 March to 20 August; Fjärås Bräcka reserve explicitly prohibits unleashed dogs.

hunting.summary: Hallandsleden advises avoiding hiking during the most intensive elk-hunting period at the beginning of October. Länsstyrelsen Halland lists elk hunting for 2025-2026 as 8 October to 31 January in elk-management and license areas.

livestockAndLandManagement.summary: Fjärås Bräcka heathland is maintained by grazing, clearing, mowing and periodic conservation burning. Expect grazing areas/gates in or near the reserve and close gates.

closuresAndReroutes.currentKnownClosure: No current official N1-specific closure, forestry warning, or active disturbance found as of 2026-04-29 beyond the 2024 reroute.
closuresAndReroutes.reroute: Official New Trail Routes page says the section was rerouted in 2024 and now goes east of Stora Iglasjön; digital map is updated and June 2022 paper maps are stale.
closuresAndReroutes.confidence: high for reroute, medium for no active closure

fireBanPolicy.summary: Municipalities decide fire bans after rescue-service consultation, with countywide bans possible. Brandrisk Ute/Krisinformation should be checked day-of-hike.

fireBanPolicy.confidence: medium for checked status, high for policy
